items.title: Cyber Anime Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Cyber-augmented, fashionable, teens are here! Join the game as the futuristic city dweller. Show your friends your new stunning look and survive the future.

+ Sci-fi
+ Futuristic teen fashion
+1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Stylish Teens 2021
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
What is your favorite character look? How about, modern, fashionable and hyping stylish teens? Try these amazing skins and let your character become trendy.

+ Teen anime fashion
+ Parkour style look
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Ninja Heroes
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
The powerful ninjas and shinobi have gathered for you to play with them. Still, they are students and on a path to learn their art and is it up to you who will be the master among them!

+ Shinobi
+ Ninjas
+ Anime
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: City Gamers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Hang out in the city and relax in cool gamer gear. Choose from lots of options and role-play as an awesome, winning player. In your headset and microphone, enjoy the city life. Remember, only you decide when the game is over.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Robot Warriors
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Great robot warriors, unite! Gear up in the helmets and armor of 8 different fighter skins. No one knows what you’re thinking behind that mask when you role-play as a member of a house or a clan. Do battle as you fly around in jet packs and use the power of your gloves to defend your planet.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Cave Camouflage
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
It’s the latest and greatest in camouflage skins. Gear up in granite or tuff mode and disappear inside the caves. Role-play and hide in the Overworld or the Nether as blocks of amethyst and calcite. Choose your favorite and stay out of sight! 

1 free skin included!

items.title: Pam's HarvestCraft: Food Core
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Experience one of Minecraft's most popular mods, now in a beautiful survival spawn! With over 100 new recipes and nine kitchen tools, this recreation of the world-renowned Java Edition mod opens up a new world of possibilities for aspiring chefs!

- Cook yogurt, muffins, pasta and much more!
- Explore a lively village
- By Pam's HarvestCraft and Pathway Studios

items.title: Trendy Anime Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
The cutest and coolest anime skins ever are here! If you are an anime lover, you will love these skins! Suit up and create the cutest kawaii team!

+ 12 anime themed skins
+ 2 free skins
+ Perfect for roleplay
+ Perfect for teens

items.title: Street Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Dress up in the latest street teen fashion trends and express your feelings with your new look! Free your inner style and hang out with your friends while looking your best!

- 20 skins
- 1 free skin
- By inPixel

items.title: Farmer Fantasy
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Get planting with the Farmer Fantasy pack! Perfect for those who love their crops more than anything else. These skins are sure to give an agricultural edge to any farmer!

- 10 fashionable farmer skins
- Fresh, simple skins with a rustic appeal!
- By thiccsnail

items.title: Lucky Skyblock Desert Valley
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
The desert has always been a great place to test one's luck! Why not try it out today? May the lucky blocks ever be in your favor!

- 10 new lucky blocks!
- Over 100 events!
- Custom skyblock survival spawn!

items.title: Pastel Pals
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Are you tired of the grunge, goth look and want to try something new? Try the new pastel pals! Comes with soft and bright colors to blend in with all of your cute pals.

- Includes 6 male and 6 female skins
- Variety of skin tones and outfits!
- By Khirbi

items.title: Galaxy Samurai
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
From the stars come legendary samurai warriors. These celestial beings roam the galaxies looking for worthy recruits to join their ranks. Will you wear their armor and travel space and time? Become a legend today!

+ Bright and colorful armor skins
+ Perfect for teens
+ Modern and cool designs
+ 12 skins

items.title: Summer Sports
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Get out in the sun and show off some skills with this athletic skin pack. Featuring 8 different summer sports. Score a goal, launch a home run, hike a mountain, surf some big ones! A total of 12 skins to choose from.

items.title: Crafty Gamer Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
These teens love to game! Are you ready to show off your skills? Crafty Gamer Teens includes skins for anything you love most about playing whether that’s skyblock or survival. Unlock these perfect teen skins for whatever game you’re playing today!

- 12 gaming teen skins!

items.title: 80s Cinema
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
The cinema is always an experience! Let's go back to the 80's and enjoy some of the classics tonight!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Classic attire inspired by theater!

items.title: ONE BLOCK SKYBLOCK!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description: One block skyblock offers an entirely new twist to skyblock game you know and love! You start with a single block and slowly expand to a block empire!

items.title: Techno Neon Demons
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These outer worldly techno suits are perfect for these demons! They look so cool and match their demon horns! Perfect for roleplay and dressing up for a neon party!

- 13 skins

items.title: Astro Mobs
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These silly looking mobs have their space goggles on to explore deep space! Which mob will you choose to be while you travel among the stars?

- 6 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Neon Techno Mobs
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Show up to the party with this sweet neon techno mob skin pack!

items.title: Teen Animals
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
ANIMAL TEENS!? That’s right! Surprise your friends by becoming a Sporty Turtle, a Designer Cat, a Mysterious Llama or even a Gangster Koala. Which animal would you want to be?
+ 10 different animals!
+ 10 different styles!
By Shape Studio

items.title: Minimalist Style
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
We all love the simple details, now is your time to show your friends the Minimalist Style!

+11 skins
by Underblocks

items.title: Fashion Enthusiasts
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
New styles all over the place! Feel the vibes and walk around wearing the latest pieces in fashion. Drive the most luxurious cars, and go shopping in your spare time! Choose the skin that fits your style the best. GAME ON!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Mega Skyblock
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Mega Skyblock is a giant world with several islands containing incredible loot!

+ Play with your friends
+ Fun for everyone
+ Custom skyblock world
